text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...No way, a pimple in a place like 
this!? Why, how could this happen...?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I've been eating properly, and my 
nutrition should be fine, but... what 
could be causing these breakouts—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Come to think of it... Maybe I haven't 
eaten cucumbers recently...?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I've been so busy, I totally neglected 
it...! Lightly pickled cucumbers and 
cucumber sesame salad... I need to eat a 
bunch!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye ended up troubled by rough 
skin...
